chunks.en: What should I know before I start at the London branch?
chunks.zh: 去倫敦分公司報到之前，我有什麼要先知道的嗎？
chunks.note: 出發前向對方請教要注意什麼。before 後面用現在式 start 講未來。

distractors.text: What should I know before I will start at the London branch?
What I should know before I start at the London branch?
What should I know before I start at London branch?

chunks.en: Is there a hotel near the office you'd recommend?
chunks.zh: 辦公室附近有沒有您推薦的飯店？
accept: Is there a hotel near the office you would recommend?
chunks.note: 請當地的人推薦住的地方。you'd recommend 直接接在 hotel 後面，說是哪一間。

distractors.text: Is there hotel near the office you'd recommend?
Are there a hotel near the office you'd recommend?
Is there a hotel near the office you'd recomend?

chunks.en: I'm here on business for two weeks, visiting our London office.
chunks.zh: 我是來出差的，待兩個星期，去我們倫敦的辦公室。
accept: I am here on business for two weeks, visiting our London office.
chunks.note: 入境時說明來做什麼、待多久。on business＝出差；短期出差別說 to work。

distractors.text: I'm here in business for two weeks, visiting our London office.
I'm here on business for two week, visiting our London office.
I'm here on a business for two weeks, visiting our London office.

chunks.en: Could you tell me where baggage claim is?
chunks.zh: 可以告訴我行李提領處在哪裡嗎？
chunks.note: 客氣地問路。Could you tell me 後面的問句用直述句的順序：where ... is。

distractors.text: Could you tell me where is baggage claim?
Could you tell me where baggage claim are?
Could you tell me where bagage claim is?

chunks.en: The hotel asked whether I needed a taxi, but I walked.
chunks.zh: 飯店問我要不要叫計程車，不過我走路來的。
chunks.note: 轉述別人問的「是不是」問句：asked whether（或 if）＋直述句，動詞往過去推一格（need → needed）。

distractors.text: The hotel asked whether did I need a taxi, but I walked.
The hotel asked whether I needed taxi, but I walked.
The hotel asked weather I needed a taxi, but I walked.

chunks.en: At immigration, they asked how long I was staying.
chunks.zh: 入境的時候，他們問我要待多久。
chunks.note: 轉述 how long、where 這類問句：疑問詞後面用直述句的順序（I was staying），不說 was I staying。

distractors.text: At immigration, they asked how long was I staying.
At immigration, they asked how long I staying.
At imigration, they asked how long I was staying.

chunks.en: Thanks for making all the arrangements for my visit.
chunks.zh: 謝謝您幫我把這趟的事情都安排好。

distractors.text: Thanks for make all the arrangements for my visit.
Thanks for making all the arrangement for my visit.
Thanks for making all the arrangments for my visit.

chunks.en: Let's move the desks closer to the window to get more light.
chunks.zh: 我們把桌子往窗邊移一點，光線會比較好。
accept: Let us move the desks closer to the window to get more light.
chunks.note: 提議東西怎麼擺。closer to＝離……近一點；to get 說目的。

distractors.text: Let's move the desks more close to the window to get more light.
Let's move the desks closer the window to get more light.
Let's moving the desks closer to the window to get more light.

chunks.en: Do you know when the internet will be set up?
chunks.zh: 您知道網路什麼時候會裝好嗎？
chunks.note: 客氣地問進度。Do you know 後面用直述句的順序：when the internet will be set up。

distractors.text: Do you know when will the internet be set up?
Do you know when the internet will set up?
Do you know when the internet will be setted up?

chunks.en: What would you do if you were in my shoes?
chunks.zh: 如果您是我，您會怎麼做？
chunks.note: 第二條件句：假設和現在不一樣的事，if＋過去式（were），另一半用 would。in my shoes＝站在我的立場。

distractors.text: What will you do if you were in my shoes?
What would you do if you are in my shoes?
What would you do if you were in my shoe?

chunks.en: I wish I had more time to see the city.
chunks.zh: 真希望我有多一點時間逛逛這個城市。
chunks.note: I wish＋過去式：希望現在的情況不一樣（其實時間不夠）。

distractors.text: I wish I have more time to see the city.
I wish I had more time see the city.
I wish I had more times to see the city.

chunks.en: I'll keep you posted on how the second shipment is going.
chunks.zh: 第二批貨的進度，我會隨時跟大家報告。
accept: I will keep you posted on how the second shipment is going.
chunks.note: 答應隨時回報進度。keep you posted on＝有消息就告訴你。

distractors.text: I'll keep you post on how the second shipment is going.
I'll keep you posted on how is the second shipment going.
I'll keep you posted on how the second shipment going.

chunks.en: It's great to finally see the Lantern lamps in your stores.
chunks.zh: 終於在您的店裡看到 Lantern 檯燈，真開心。
accept: It is great to finally see the Lantern lamps in your stores.
chunks.note: 到客戶店裡時表達開心。finally＝等了很久，終於。

distractors.text: It's great to finally seeing the Lantern lamps in your stores.
It's great to final see the Lantern lamps in your stores.
It's great to finally see the Lantern lamps on your stores.

chunks.en: How are customers responding to the new lamps so far?
chunks.zh: 到目前為止，客人對新檯燈的反應怎麼樣？
chunks.note: 問客人的反應。respond to＝對……有反應；so far＝到目前為止。

distractors.text: How are customers responding the new lamps so far?
How is customers responding to the new lamps so far?
How are customers respond to the new lamps so far?

words.zh: 不動產（estate agent 房屋仲介）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Can you hear me? This is our new London office.
scene.zh: 嗨！聽得到嗎？這裡就是我們倫敦的新辦公室。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're going global. We're here to establish a base in Europe.
scene.zh: 我們要走向全球了。我們在這裡，是要在歐洲建立據點。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're a small regional office now, but we plan to expand.
scene.zh: 我們現在只是個小小的區域辦公室，不過之後打算擴大。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What should I know before I start at the London branch?
scene.zh: 去倫敦分公司報到之前，我有什麼要先知道的嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, you won't need a visa for a short business trip.
scene.zh: 嗯，短期出差的話，你不需要簽證。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And headquarters is paying your airfare.
scene.zh: 機票錢由總公司出。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is there a hotel near the office you'd recommend?
scene.zh: 辦公室附近有沒有您推薦的飯店？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, there's a nice one ten minutes away.
scene.zh: 有，走路十分鐘有一間不錯的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And bring your briefcase. Mr. Hughes wants to meet you.
scene.zh: 還有，公事包記得帶著。Hughes 先生想跟你見個面。

fills.en: Welcome ___! Blankets and headphones are on your seat.
fills.zh: 歡迎登機！毯子和耳機都放在您的座位上。
fills.note: 在飛機上歡迎乘客說 welcome aboard。

fills.en: Excuse me, could you tell me where ___?
fills.zh: 不好意思，可以告訴我洗手間在哪裡嗎？
fills.note: 間接問句用直述句順序：主詞＋is。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning. Passport, please. What's the reason for your visit?
scene.zh: 早安。請給我護照。您這次來的目的是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm here on business for two weeks, visiting our London office.
scene.zh: 我是來出差的，待兩個星期，去我們倫敦的辦公室。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I see you flew in overnight via New York.
scene.zh: 我看到您是搭夜班飛機、經紐約過來的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Two hours in transit, too. That's a long journey.
scene.zh: 還在那邊轉機兩個小時，這趟路可真長。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Try not to sleep before tonight. That's the best way to beat jet lag.
scene.zh: 晚上之前盡量別睡，這是對付時差最好的方法。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All right, you're all set. Welcome to London.
scene.zh: 好了，都辦好了。歡迎來到倫敦。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you tell me where baggage claim is?
scene.zh: 可以告訴我行李提領處在哪裡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Go straight ahead. It's just past the restrooms, on your left.
scene.zh: 一直往前走，過了洗手間就到了，在您左手邊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning, and welcome! Did you find us all right?
scene.zh: 早安，歡迎！路上還好找嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The hotel asked whether I needed a taxi, but I walked.
scene.zh: 飯店問我要不要叫計程車，不過我走路來的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good for you. It's only a kilometer, and a pleasant walk.
scene.zh: 很好啊。才一公里，走起來很舒服。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And how was the airport? No trouble, I hope.
scene.zh: 那機場呢？希望沒遇到什麼麻煩。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: At immigration, they asked how long I was staying.
scene.zh: 入境的時候，他們問我要待多久。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's normal. They ask everyone that.
scene.zh: 那很正常，他們每個人都會問。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This district is very accessible. The subway is right around the corner.
scene.zh: 這一區交通很方便，地鐵站就在轉角。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Take the Tube to work. The traffic jams here are terrible.
scene.zh: 上班就搭地鐵吧。這裡塞車很可怕。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the hotel concierge can help with any other transportation.
scene.zh: 其他交通的事，飯店的禮賓人員都可以幫忙。

texts.title: Your Trip to London
lines: August 2, 6:30 p.m.: Overnight flight to London Heathrow via New York (2 hours in transit)
August 3, 7:00 a.m.: Arrive in London. Take the subway or a taxi to your hotel in the city.
August 9: Free day. If you like, join an excursion to Oxford by train. Check the timetable at the station.
August 17, 10:00 a.m.: Flight home
Travel tips: Blankets and headphones are given to every traveler aboard. UK outlets are different, so bring an adapter.

texts.title: Welcome to London!
lines: Hello from London!
Your hotel is conveniently close to the office, about ten minutes away.
Our landlord is doing renovation work in the building, so the front door is closed. For now, we use the door at the side of the building.
Courier packages for tenants now go to the basement, so the box of Lantern samples you sent will be there.
All visitors need registration at the front desk on their first day.
Let's start at 9:30 on Monday, August 4.
Ms. Wright

texts.title: Renovation Notice
lines: To all tenants:
There will be construction in the hallway on the second floor from August 4 to August 15.
During this time, the front door on Hill Street is unavailable. Please use the side door on King Street.
The hallway will reopen on August 18. Thank you for your patience.

questions.en: Where is the traveler in transit, and for how long?
questions.zh: 這位旅客在哪裡轉機？轉機多久？

questions.en: Where will the Lantern samples be?
questions.zh: Lantern 的樣品會放在哪裡？

questions.en: Which door should the visitor use on August 4?
questions.zh: 訪客八月四日要走哪一個門？
options: The front door on Hill Street
The side door on King Street

questions.en: Will the traveler still be in London when the hallway reopens?
questions.zh: 走廊重新開放時，這位旅客還在倫敦嗎？
options: No, the flight home is the day before
Yes, the flight home is that evening

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry about the noise. The landlord is doing some renovation work this month.
scene.zh: 不好意思，有點吵。房東這個月在做一些整修。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's why we're using the side door for now.
scene.zh: 所以我們現在都走側門。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The construction in the hallway should be finished by the fifteenth.
scene.zh: 走廊的施工應該十五號就會做完。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the courier brought your box of samples. It's down in the basement.
scene.zh: 還有，快遞把你的樣品箱送來了，放在地下室。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for making all the arrangements for my visit.
scene.zh: 謝謝您幫我把這趟的事情都安排好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. Just don't forget your registration at the front desk.
scene.zh: 別客氣。只是別忘了去櫃台登記。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And if you're free on Saturday, you should really go on the Oxford excursion.
scene.zh: 還有，星期六有空的話，真的該去 Oxford 走走。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's only an hour by train, and the old town is beautiful.
scene.zh: 搭火車只要一個小時，老城區很漂亮。

lines.en: The estate agent found this office for us. It was already furnished.
lines.zh: 這間辦公室是房屋仲介幫我們找的，本來就附了家具。

lines.en: And the rest of the furniture came yesterday, right?
lines.zh: 其他的家具昨天也到了，對吧？

lines.en: Yes. But the modem isn't set up yet. The internet company comes at two.
lines.zh: 對。不過數據機還沒裝，網路公司兩點才會來。

lines.en: Two o'clock today? Good. I need to send some emails.
lines.zh: 今天兩點？太好了，我有幾封 email 要寄。

lines.en: I'd like the meeting table by the window. There's ample room there.
lines.zh: 我想把會議桌放在窗邊，那邊空間很夠。

lines.en: Good idea. And where should the shelves go?
lines.zh: 好主意。那架子要放哪裡？

lines.en: Wherever you like. It's your office too.
lines.zh: 你想放哪裡都可以，這也是你的辦公室。

lines.en: Thanks! Does the building have a kitchen?
lines.zh: 謝謝！這棟大樓有廚房嗎？

lines.en: Yes, and a small gym, too. The amenities here are great.
lines.zh: 有，還有一間小健身房。這裡的設施很不錯。

lines.en: Next month, an interior designer is coming to redecorate the meeting room.
lines.zh: 下個月會有室內設計師來重新裝潢會議室。

questions.en: When will the internet company come?
questions.zh: 網路公司什麼時候會來？

questions.en: Where will the meeting table go?
What will they do next month?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right, the rest of the furniture came yesterday. Where should we start?
scene.zh: 好，其他的家具昨天到了。我們從哪裡開始？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's move the desks closer to the window to get more light.
scene.zh: 我們把桌子往窗邊移一點，光線會比較好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. There's ample room over there.
scene.zh: 好主意，那邊空間很夠。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then we can rearrange the chairs around them.
scene.zh: 然後再把椅子圍著桌子重新擺一擺。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you know when the internet will be set up?
scene.zh: 您知道網路什麼時候會裝好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The modem's here, but they won't come until two.
scene.zh: 數據機到了，不過他們兩點才會來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So far, everything's going smoothly.
scene.zh: 到目前為止，一切都很順利。

textFills.title: A few tips for London
lines: Cultural differences can feel unfamiliar at first, but most visitors adapt quickly.
Native speakers here have many different ___, so don't worry if you miss a word.
If I ___ you, I'd just ask them to say it again.
Say please and thank you, and always wait your turn in line.
Ms. Wright
zh: 文化上的差異一開始可能會讓人覺得陌生，不過大部分的訪客很快就適應了。
就連本地人的口音也有很多種，所以漏聽一個字也別擔心。
如果我是你，我就直接請對方再說一次。
要說「請」和「謝謝」，排隊也一定要照順序。

blanks.note: 說話的方式不同，是口音 accents。
If I were you 是固定的假設說法。

options: Good manners are also important here.
Your flight home leaves on Sunday.
The modem is in the basement.
blanks.note: 下一句講說請、謝謝和排隊，是禮貌。

prompt.en: How are you adapting to life in London?
prompt.zh: 你在倫敦的生活適應得怎麼樣？

responses.en: Pretty well. People here are really friendly.
responses.zh: 還不錯，這裡的人都很友善。

prompt.en: When does your flight home leave?
prompt.zh: 你回去的班機什麼時候起飛？

responses.en: On the seventeenth, in the morning.

prompt.en: How did you interpret his email?
prompt.zh: 你怎麼理解他那封 email？

responses.en: His email address is on the card.
responses.zh: 他的 email 地址在名片上。

responses.en: I think he wants to meet next week.
responses.zh: 我想他是希望下週見面。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I hear Mr. Hughes invited you to dinner at his home on Sunday.
scene.zh: 聽說 Hughes 先生邀你星期天去他家吃晚餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's quite a courtesy. He doesn't do that for everyone.
scene.zh: 這可是很給面子，他不是每個人都請的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What would you do if you were in my shoes?
scene.zh: 如果您是我，您會怎麼做？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If I were you, I'd bring flowers or a box of chocolates.
scene.zh: 如果我是你，我會帶束花或一盒巧克力。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Traditionally, that's the custom here. And don't arrive early.
scene.zh: 這裡傳統上就是這樣的習慣。還有，別提早到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, have you seen any of the big attractions yet?
scene.zh: 對了，你去過哪些有名的景點了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I wish I had more time to see the city.
scene.zh: 真希望我有多一點時間逛逛這個城市。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then use your free day on Saturday. Most museums here are free!
scene.zh: 那就好好利用星期六的空檔。這裡大部分的博物館都免費！

lines.en: Good morning, everyone, and good afternoon to our team in London.
lines.zh: 大家早安，也跟倫敦的同事說聲午安。

lines.en: Since we're in different time zones, let's keep this videoconference to thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 因為我們在不同的時區，這場視訊會議就控制在三十分鐘內。

lines.en: Our first Lantern shipment reached the UK at the end of July, and it's already selling in Mr. Hughes's stores.
lines.zh: 第一批 Lantern 七月底就到了英國，已經在 Hughes 先生的店裡賣了。

lines.en: The second shipment left Taiwan by sea freight last week. It should arrive at the end of August.
lines.zh: 第二批貨上週從台灣走海運出發，應該八月底會到。

lines.en: When our two companies cooperate like this, the benefit is mutual.
lines.zh: 兩家公司像這樣合作，對雙方都有好處。

lines.en: During this transition, please correspond by email as much as you can.
lines.zh: 在這段過渡期，請大家盡量用 email 聯絡。

lines.en: In remote meetings, the time difference is the biggest barrier, so please write important things down.
lines.zh: 遠端開會時，時差是最大的障礙，所以重要的事請寫下來。

lines.en: Next year, we may relocate someone to London, and we'll look for an external shipping company.
lines.zh: 明年我們可能會調一個人到倫敦，也會找一家外部的貨運公司。

lines.en: Harbor Trading is finally selling its own products internationally. Thank you all for your hard work.
lines.zh: Harbor Trading 終於在國際上賣自己的產品了。謝謝大家的努力。

questions.en: Why will the meeting be short?
questions.zh: 為什麼會議會開得很短？
options: They are in different time zones
Ms. Carter has to leave early

questions.en: When will the second shipment reach the UK?
questions.zh: 第二批貨什麼時候會到英國？

questions.en: What may the company do next year?
questions.zh: 公司明年可能會做什麼？
options: Send someone to work in London

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Can you hear me? The video's slow today.
scene.zh: 嗨！聽得到嗎？今天視訊有點慢。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's two in the afternoon there, right? How's London?
scene.zh: 你那邊是下午兩點吧？倫敦怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I wish I had more time to see the city.
scene.zh: 真希望我有多一點時間逛逛這個城市。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next time, then. So, any news on the second shipment?
scene.zh: 那就下次吧。對了，第二批貨有什麼消息嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll keep you posted on how the second shipment is going.
scene.zh: 第二批貨的進度，我會隨時跟大家報告。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. Remote work isn't easy, but you're doing great.
scene.zh: 謝謝。遠距工作不容易，不過你做得很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Say hi to Ms. Wright for me.
scene.zh: 幫我跟 Wright 小姐問聲好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thank you for having us, Mr. Hughes.
scene.zh: Hughes 先生，謝謝您招待我們。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My pleasure. Come in and have a look around.
scene.zh: 不客氣。請進，隨便看看。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It's great to finally see the Lantern lamps in your stores.
scene.zh: 終於在您的店裡看到 Lantern 檯燈，真開心。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That warm light gives the whole room a nice atmosphere.
scene.zh: 那種暖暖的光，讓整個空間的氣氛都很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the deluxe model looks so elegant on that table by the window.
scene.zh: 而且高級款擺在窗邊那張桌子上，看起來好有質感。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How are customers responding to the new lamps so far?
scene.zh: 到目前為止，客人對新檯燈的反應怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Very well. Residents love them, and tourists buy them as gifts.
scene.zh: 很好。當地居民很喜歡，觀光客也會買來送人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our rural stores have sold out of the deluxe model.
scene.zh: 我們鄉下的幾家店，高級款都賣光了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! Come in. Sorry about all the boxes.
scene.zh: 早安！請進。不好意思，到處都是箱子。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for making all the arrangements for my visit.
scene.zh: 謝謝您幫我把這趟的事情都安排好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. Did you get here all right from the hotel?
scene.zh: 別客氣。從飯店過來還順利嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The hotel asked whether I needed a taxi, but I walked.
scene.zh: 飯店問我要不要叫計程車，不過我走路來的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good for you. It's a pleasant walk in the morning.
scene.zh: 很好啊。早上走過來很舒服。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What should I know before I start at the London branch?
scene.zh: 去倫敦分公司報到之前，我有什麼要先知道的嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not much. We're small and friendly. The only problem is the internet.
scene.zh: 沒什麼。我們人不多，大家都很好相處。唯一的問題是網路。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you know when the internet will be set up?
scene.zh: 您知道網路什麼時候會裝好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This afternoon, I hope. And look who's here. Mr. Hughes!
scene.zh: 希望是今天下午。你看誰來了，Hughes 先生！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello! So you're the one from Harbor Trading. How long are you with us?
scene.zh: 你好！你就是 Harbor Trading 派來的吧。會在這裡待多久？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm here on business for two weeks, visiting our London office.
scene.zh: 我是來出差的，待兩個星期，去我們倫敦的辦公室。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Then Ms. Wright should accompany you to one of my stores.
scene.zh: 很好。那 Wright 小姐該帶你去我的店看看。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How are customers responding to the new lamps so far?
scene.zh: 到目前為止，客人對新檯燈的反應怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Very well. Tourism is strong this summer, so we'll need more lamps soon.
scene.zh: 很好。今年夏天觀光客很多，我們很快就需要更多貨了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll keep you posted on how the second shipment is going.
scene.zh: 第二批貨的進度，我會隨時跟大家報告。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thank you. Good relations matter in this business.
scene.zh: 謝謝。做這行，關係好很重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And make sure you see a bit of London while you're here.
scene.zh: 還有，你在這裡的時候，一定要去倫敦逛逛。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I wish I had more time to see the city.
scene.zh: 真希望我有多一點時間逛逛這個城市。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then take Saturday off. That's an order!
scene.zh: 那星期六就休息吧。這是命令！
